about.title: About
about.body1: This site answers one question: what can I cook with what I already have? You list ingredients; the catalog answers with dishes.
about.body2: The catalog is curated and shared. Two clients, a Vue app and a Flutter app, read the same data, so a dish means the same thing everywhere.
about.body3: Every dish, ingredient and comment on this site comes from a real entry or a seed record. Nothing here is invented proof, and empty lists stay empty until someone writes something.
about.body4: The interface is available in English and Vietnamese, and catalog entries can carry both languages.
